name: Softcat plc
summary: Softcat plc operates as a value-added IT reseller and IT infrastructure solutions provider in the United Kingdom. The company advices, procures, designs, implements, and manages digital infrastructure, such as hybrid infrastructure, workplace, cyber security, networking and connectivity, data, automation, and AI for businesses and public sector organizations. It also provides public cloud, collaboration, data centre and private cloud, devices, and financial solution services.
